blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta tells everyone to stop wandering around in philosophical confusion, makes an ordinary clay pot reveal the structure of consciousness, explains why awareness cannot be manufactured by the things it knows, and finally introduces the four strangest vowels in Sanskrit, which apparently possess the generative capacity of roasted seeds.
